research.title: Financing the Future of Defense: Admiral Pierre Vandier on Innovation and Investment
research.summary: Admiral Pierre Vandier, NATO's Supreme Allied Commander Transformation, joins Daniel Rudnicki Schlumberger, head of the Security and Resiliency Initiative for EMEA, to discuss what the war in Ukraine has revealed about modern defense — and the role private capital must now play in building the industrial base.
